diagnostic_rule: Attribute the already-observed degraded-surface failures using public authoritative package/index/manpage evidence only. Do not replay the spent gate, mutate runtime, add package hints, or claim counterfactual acceptance ranks.

evidence: The spent execution surface imported only Debian trixie main/Contents-amd64.gz.
The Debian trixie archive publishes Contents-all.gz separately from Contents-amd64.gz.
libimage-exiftool-perl is Architecture: all and its package file list contains /usr/bin/exiftool.
Therefore an apt-file cache constructed only from Contents-amd64.gz omits the oracle executable for an architecture-all package.
findings.implication: The EXIF miss is not admissible evidence of an intrinsic PR85 discovery failure. A faithful cache must include architecture-all Contents data.

evidence: PR85 sorts matched command paths and enriches the first path only; for libjpeg-turbo-progs this selects cjpeg rather than jpegtran.
Ubuntu Noble's cjpeg manpage contains the requested goal token JPEG and additional semantic terms used by the generic matcher, including perform and without.
The spent runtime had no outbound network, so none of that bounded manpage enrichment was available.
A separate jpegtran manpage is strongly aligned with lossless transformation, but PR85 does not select it under the current first-sorted-path enrichment rule.
findings.implication: Missing manpage enrichment can improve this oracle's semantic coverage and rank, but the exact top-20 counterfactual cannot be claimed without a complete normal surface.

evidence: libxml2-utils exposes /usr/bin/xmlcatalog and /usr/bin/xmllint; PR85 sorts paths and enriches the first path, xmlcatalog.
Ubuntu Noble's xmlcatalog manpage describes parsing/manipulating XML or SGML catalogs and diagnostics, not XML document validation/syntax checking.
Therefore restoring network access would enrich xmlcatalog, not the semantically better xmllint command.
Normal APT Packages metadata was also absent in the spent run and can alter metadata score/tie-breaking, so an exact top-20 counterfactual remains unresolved.
findings.implication: The degraded environment cannot fully explain the XML semantic mismatch. A generic command-selection/ranking residual remains plausible and must be tested only on a newly frozen held-out gate before any second repair.

wall_clock_conclusion: The original evidence-acquisition latency blocker is materially improved because the exact three-case runner completed in 96.824453 seconds under the degraded surface, well below the 600 second gate.

sources.finding: Debian publishes Contents-all.gz separately from Contents-amd64.gz.
ExifTool is semantically aligned with EXIF/camera/JPEG metadata extraction.
xmlcatalog is a catalog manipulation command; it is the path PR85 would enrich before xmllint.
cjpeg manpage provides additional generic semantic evidence beyond its executable name.

prohibited_inference: Do not treat this post-hoc attribution as a fresh acceptance run.
Do not infer exact counterfactual oracle ranks without a complete normal APT surface.
Do not authorize merge/promotion of PR85 from this diagnostic.
Do not implement a second repair before attribution reconciliation and a new held-out gate are frozen.
